nodes.label: applicationId com.example.teacher
nodes.rationale: Inherited from Flutter template; changing it changes app identity and breaks upgrades over installed builds, so it requires explicit product-owner decision and migration plan. CI verifies it but never changes it.

nodes.label: Changelog (Keep a Changelog)
nodes.rationale: Version sections must match pubspec.yaml; CI reads the matching section and sends it to backend as release changelog, failing if missing.

nodes.label: Release rollback and recovery runbook
nodes.rationale: Backend metadata is not auto-reverted after failed verification because that could hide infrastructure problems and needs a human decision.

nodes.label: Atomic server upload (.part, SHA-256 verify, .backup, mv)
nodes.norm_label: atomic server upload (.part, sha-256 verify, .backup, mv)

nodes.label: Release runs never cancelled (cancel-in-progress: false)
nodes.rationale: Prevents half-finished uploads/publishes.

nodes.label: SERVER_KNOWN_HOSTS mandatory host-key pinning
nodes.rationale: Workflow never disables host-key verification (no StrictHostKeyChecking=no).

nodes.label: Production-only signing model (Gradle guard + cert comparison)
nodes.norm_label: production-only signing model (gradle guard + cert comparison)
nodes.rationale: Gradle throws if keystore.properties is missing so the old debug-signing fallback cannot silently ship.

nodes.label: Rollback ground rules (never decrement version_code, never rotate signing key)
nodes.norm_label: rollback ground rules (never decrement version_code, never rotate signing key)
nodes.rationale: Installed apps only accept updates signed with the same certificate and higher versionCode.

nodes.label: Availability safeguard (temporary continue after two failures)
nodes.norm_label: availability safeguard (temporary continue after two failures)
nodes.rationale: Prevents a corrupt server artifact from bricking every client while re-checking on next start.

nodes.label: Fail-open update check / mandatory vs optional
nodes.norm_label: fail-open update check / mandatory vs optional
nodes.rationale: Users are not locked out by a backend outage; optional releases never auto-download.

nodes.label: Root cause of 'problem parsing the package' error
nodes.norm_label: root cause of 'problem parsing the package' error
nodes.rationale: Old implementation only checked ZIP magic bytes and reused cached app-update.apk without integrity checks, so truncated/stale files reached the installer.

nodes.norm_label: pubspec.yaml version as single source of truth (versionname+versioncode)
nodes.rationale: versionCode must always increase and never be reused or decreased; every version needs a matching CHANGELOG section.

nodes.label: Launch Screen Assets
nodes.rationale: Launch screen customized by replacing image files here or via Xcode Runner.xcworkspace Assets.xcassets.

nodes.label: Decorative Background Illustration
nodes.rationale: Light gray, thin strokes and abstract geometry indicate it is meant to sit behind content (e.g. onboarding or card backgrounds) without competing for attention. Exact semantic meaning (angle diagram, trajectory, vector/axes sketch) is uncertain.

nodes.label: item2.png (decorative line-art asset)
nodes.rationale: Minimal light-gray line illustration on a transparent/white background: two arrows diverging from a single vertex (one pointing up-right, one pointing down-right) with a hand-drawn wavy curve between them. Low-contrast styling suggests a subtle decorative/background element rather than functional UI.

nodes.label: Cartesian Coordinate System (x/y axes)
nodes.rationale: Explicitly labeled x and y axes with an arrow on the y-axis.

nodes.label: Mathematics / Graphing Theme
nodes.rationale: The plot-style imagery suggests the app (or the item using this asset) relates to math/curves/graph plotting; app purpose is inferred.

nodes.label: Spiral Curve
nodes.rationale: Outward-winding spiral centered at the origin; exact type (Archimedean vs logarithmic) is AMBIGUOUS from the drawing.

nodes.label: item3.png (spiral on x-y axes illustration)
nodes.rationale: Minimal light-grey line-art icon/illustration on transparent/white background, likely used as a decorative list item or card graphic in the Flutter app; muted gray stroke suggests a subtle background/placeholder visual rather than a primary UI element.

nodes.label: graphify usage rules for agents
nodes.rationale: Query the knowledge graph before raw grep/file reads to get a scoped subgraph; run graphify update after code changes.

nodes.label: Linux relocatable install bundle
nodes.rationale: Only the bundled executable launches correctly since resources must be at relative locations; unbundled copy placed in intermediates_do_not_run.

nodes.label: flutter_assemble target (Linux)
nodes.rationale: _phony_ output forces tool_backend.sh to run every build since the flutter tool provides no full input/output list.

nodes.label: list_prepend()
nodes.rationale: Replacement for list(TRANSFORM ... PREPEND) which is unavailable in CMake 3.10.

nodes.label: Windows in-place install next to executable
nodes.norm_label: windows in-place install next to executable
nodes.rationale: Support files copied next to the executable instead of a separate bundle (as on Linux) so building and running in Visual Studio works.

nodes.label: Stack of Bookmarked Books
nodes.rationale: Five oversized books with bookmarks. They represent study material or resources.

nodes.label: Education / Learning Theme
nodes.rationale: Main message of the illustration: studying and academic achievement.

nodes.label: Globe
nodes.rationale: Suggests worldwide knowledge, or learning that is open to anyone anywhere.

nodes.label: Graduation Cap

nodes.rationale: Flat vector illustration with no text, used as the second onboarding screen artwork. Its education theme (students, books, graduation cap, globe) suggests the app is about learning or studying. Muted gray, orange and peach palette with thick dark outlines on a white background.

nodes.label: Chalkboard with Equations (x+y=1, e=mc2)

nodes.label: Apple Silhouette Motif

nodes.label: est. 2024
nodes.rationale: Small text near the R's base indicating the brand was established in 2024.

nodes.label: MR Monogram
nodes.rationale: Letters M (dark red) and R (orange-red) joined with curled swirl terminals and small metallic studs; matches the repo name MR, so likely the brand initials.

nodes.label: Red-Orange Gradient Palette

nodes.label: App Icon (app_icon.png)
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square launcher icon on white background; glossy 3D red-to-orange 'MR' monogram shaped as an apple with two green leaves on top, enclosed by a thin red outline; signals a fresh/food (fruit) brand identity.

nodes.label: Reserved Font Name restriction
